app.name: Majlis
app.tagline: Voice-first consumer research in Saudi dialects

home.title: Hear your customers in their own dialect
home.description: Voice interviews run by a self-disclosing AI assistant, with analysis that builds a consumer memory across studies.

studies.title: Studies
studies.empty: No studies yet. Start with a one-sentence goal.

newStudy.title: New study
newStudy.objectiveHint: e.g. Why do customers stop using our app?

guide.sensitive: Sensitive: asked gently with an opt-out, never followed up

segment.hint: Leave a group empty to accept everyone.

invite.whatsappText: Tell us what you think about {topic} in a short voice interview: {url}
invite.notOpen: The link does not accept participants until recruiting is open.

sessions.privacy: Transcripts are de-identified: phone numbers, emails and IDs are removed automatically.

participant.closed: This study is not accepting participants right now. Thank you for your interest.
participant.welcomeBody: We'd like to hear what you think about {topic}. It is short ({duration}), by voice or text, and never uses the camera.
participant.pointAi: You will be talking with an AI assistant, not a person.
participant.pointPrivate: We never ask for your name or number, and the client sees your words without anything that identifies you.
participant.pointRegion: Your data is stored inside Saudi Arabia.
participant.aboutHint: This helps us understand views by group. You can skip it.
participant.screenerRequired: Please answer the screener questions to continue.
participant.disclosureLabel: This is what the interviewer says first:
participant.consentInterview: I agree to take part. I understand the interviewer is an AI assistant and my answers are kept for research.
participant.consentAudio: The client may listen to clips of my voice (optional).
participant.screenedOut: Thank you! This study is looking for a different group this time.
participant.failed: We couldn't start the interview. Please try again.
participant.micDenied: We couldn't access the microphone. You can continue by typing.
participant.thanksBody: Thanks for your time and your views.
participant.deletionBody: Keep this code. If you later want your participation and all your data deleted, enter it on the deletion page.

results.empty: No results yet. They appear once interviews are completed and analyzed.
results.baseline: Sentiment is a baseline from a Saudi-dialect lexicon; its accuracy has not been measured on labelled data yet.

memory.title: Ask your memory
memory.hint: Ask about your customers, e.g. What do women in Jeddah think about our prices?
memory.insufficient: The interviews don't contain enough on this question.
memory.extractive: From {quotes} quotes in {sessions} interviews: {positive} positive, {negative} negative, {neutral} neutral.
memory.llmNote: Written only from the quotes below; bracketed numbers refer to them.
memory.parenthood: We don't record whether a participant is a parent, so only gender was used.
memory.personasEmpty: Personas form once a segment has at least {min} completed interviews.

whatsapp.help: Hi! Send the study code from your invitation to begin.
whatsapp.closed: This study is not accepting participants right now. Thank you for your interest.
whatsapp.privacy: Before we start: WhatsApp messages pass through Meta's servers outside Saudi Arabia. If you prefer, you can take part from the invitation link in your browser instead.
whatsapp.deleteHint:
You can send "delete" at any time and we will erase your participation and all your data. Keep this deletion code: {code}
We delete your number {days} days after your last message; after that you can still delete your participation with the code at: {url}
whatsapp.deleted: Your participation and all your data have been deleted. Thank you.

deletion.title: Delete my participation
deletion.body: Enter the code shown at the end of your interview. We delete the recordings, transcripts and all data linked to your participation. This cannot be undone.
deletion.done: Your participation and all your data have been deleted.
deletion.notFound: No participation matches this code. Check it and try again.

review.title: Review and quality
review.forbidden: This page is for reviewers and administrators only.
review.metricsHint: Actual numbers computed from human reviews; shown as they are, even when below target.
review.failed: Could not save, please try again.
review.rateHint: Listen to the line and rate its naturalness from 1 (very robotic) to 5 (fully natural).
